notes: CACI International Inc FY2024 10-K (fiscal year ending June 30, 2024). Defense IT services prime. The filing names NO specific Pentagon Program Elements (PE numbers) and NO specific named DoD programs in the J-Book corpus (no Skyborg, no CCA, no SDA, no Project Maven, no JADC2, no EWPMT, no TITAN program-of-record). Disclosures are at the customer-concentration / segment level (DoD = 74.4% of FY24 revenue; intel/defense/federal civilian mix). The 10-K explicitly states 'It is uncertain at this time which of our programs funding could be reduced in future years' — i.e. the company itself does not name specific PEs. This is structurally a low-J-Book-leverage company for this cohort: most claims will land as UNVERIFIABLE for pentagon_jbook with usaspending as the relevant cross-check.

claims.claim_text: CACI provides multi-domain command, control, communications, and computer (C4) intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) technology and networks; software-defined signals intelligence, electronic warfare, and counter-unmanned aircraft system (C-UAS) solutions, including 5G/mmWave wireless communications on/off the battlefield.
claims.subject: CACI
claims.object_value: C4ISR / SIGINT / EW / C-UAS / 5G+mmWave for battlefield
claims.source_quote: Our software-defined signals intelligence, electronic warfare, and counter-unmanned aircraft system (C-UAS) solutions provide electromagnetic spectrum advantage and deliver precision effects against national security threats. We are at the forefront of developing technologies that meet the challenges of 5G and mmWave wireless communications both on and off the battlefield.

claims.claim_text: CACI is at the forefront of developing technologies that use lasers for free space optical (FSO) communications and long-range sensing in the space domain.
claims.subject: CACI
claims.source_quote: We are at the forefront of developing technologies that use lasers for free space optical communications and long-range sensing.

claims.claim_text: During fiscal 2022, CACI completed four acquisitions whose capabilities include open source intelligence solutions, specialized cyber, satellite communications, multi-domain photonics technologies for free-space optical (FSO) communications, and commercial solutions for classified (CSfC) security technologies (aggregate consideration ~$616.6M; $450.5M goodwill, $180.6M intangibles).
claims.subject: CACI
claims.source_quote: During fiscal 2022, CACI completed four acquisitions that provide technology to sensitive government customers. Their capabilities include open source intelligence solutions, specialized cyber, satellite communications, multi-domain photonics technologies for free-space optical (FSO) communications, and commercial solutions for classified (CSfC) security technologies.
